# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Top pick: Soundcore Space One, $99.99 (about $80 with a code)**
- Best Products ranks it best overall under $100. It has adaptive ANC, a comfy rotating-cup design, a good app with EQ, and a 55-hour battery. It's a bit heavy.
- Dealectric tested the code AFSC20 in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, and it took the price from $99.99 to $80. It doesn't work on items already on sale, and the store's checkout has the final word.
- [Buy at Soundcore's US store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- Source: [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)

**Strongest noise cancelling: Soundcore Space Q45, about $100**
- RTINGS named it the best budget noise-cancelling headphone it has tested. It handles engine rumble and office chatter well and comes with a hard case.
- Its battery is 28 hours per RTINGS. CartIQ claims 50 hours with ANC off, so I'd trust the lab testing.
- Some owners report the headband cracking, so handle it gently.
- [See price and buy links on RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Best cheaper alternative: Soundcore Life Q20 (2024)**
- RTINGS says its noise isolation is nearly as good as the Q45's, with 49 hours of battery.
- It's weaker on bass rumble, uses a pouch instead of a hard case, and the plastic feels hollow.
- [RTINGS review with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Lightweight Sony option: Sony WH-CH720N, about $99**
- CartIQ says it weighs only 192g and has good dual-sensor ANC. It supports only SBC and AAC, with no LDAC.
- [CartIQ's roundup with Amazon link](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

**Cheapest picks**
- **Edifier Atom Max, about $45:** ANC rated up to 44dB, 45-hour battery, foldable, but no headphone jack. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE, about $65:** 70-hour battery and wired USB-C, but weaker ANC and no app. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)

**Others worth knowing**
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q30:** RTINGS's top over-ear under $100, with the best ANC on its list and 44 hours of battery. It leaks sound, so it's less ideal for quiet offices. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)
- **CMF Headphone Pro:** RTINGS calls it the most durable budget pick, with stainless steel hinges. Its noise isolation is weaker. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **JBL Tune 760NC (about $79):** Best for calls and bass, but its ANC is mediocre. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)

Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
